$comment: Predetermined safety responses. These bypass the LLM entirely. review_status records that they are project-authored and MUST be reviewed by a qualified clinician before any real deployment.

eye_emergency.message: Severe eye pain, sudden changes in vision, a chemical or object in the eye, or an eye injury can need prompt care. Please don't rely on this app for that. Contact an eye-care professional, urgent care, or emergency services now. If a chemical got into your eye, rinse it with clean water while you seek help.

stroke_signs.message: Sudden face drooping, weakness or numbness on one side, trouble speaking, or confusion can be signs of a medical emergency. Please contact emergency services immediately — don't wait to see if it improves.

airway_allergy.message: Swelling of the lips, tongue, face or throat, or any difficulty breathing or swallowing, can be a serious allergic reaction. Please contact emergency services now.

chest_or_collapse.message: Chest pain, fainting, or a severe sudden headache can need urgent medical attention. Please contact emergency services or seek urgent care now.

self_harm.message: I'm really sorry you're going through this. You deserve support from a person right now. If you might act on thoughts of harming yourself, please contact your local emergency number. In the US you can call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline); elsewhere, local crisis lines can help.

severe_skin.message: Rapidly spreading redness, blistering, skin that is hot and very painful, or a rash with fever can need prompt medical assessment. Please contact a healthcare professional or urgent care rather than relying on this app.
